detail.summary: Reviewed all 6 Python files under src/ and wrote findings.json with exactly one defect type per file. Conclusions: alpha.py=off_by_one (`sum(items[:-1])` drops the last element); beta.py=mutable_default (`bucket=[]` default argument); gamma.py=shadowed_builtin (`sum = 0` shadows builtin `sum`); delta.py=wrong_except (bare `except:` catches everything instead of `except ValueError`); epsilon.py=integer_division (`a // b` instead of true division); zeta.py=unclosed_resource (`open()` result never closed). Self-check confirmed the JSON has all 6 filenames as keys, matches the src/ listing exactly, all values are from the allowed wordlist, and all 6 values are used (once each).
evidence: src/ listing: alpha.py beta.py delta.py epsilon.py gamma.py zeta.py
python3 self-check: keys match True, values valid True, 6 unique values
